【原视频简介】
Normally you’d throw moldy dragonfruit in the garbage, but I placed it in a terracotta pot to see if I could grow 100+ baby dragons. Since dragonfruits grow into cactuses…I was hyped to see if they would really grow.🐉

Well guess what? It did grow and now I have an army of baby cactuses in my house! This….is the full story!👀

I was able to track every stage of my experiment using my app: Grow It! There are over 400 experiments to try out…so download it and start one with me!!
